title: Newton County Sheriff's Office break ground on new evidence facility - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Newton County breaks ground on new evidence facility. Matt Stewart speaks to the crowd. Courtesy NCMSO. Newton County breaks ground on new evidence facility. Matt Stewart speaks to the crowd. Courtesy NCMSO.
NEOSHO, Mo. (KOAM/KJFX) — Newton County Missouri Sheriff Matt Stewart spoke at the groundbreaking for their new evidence facility.
“The project was designed by Corner Greer Architects, and we have been working with them for the last several months designing a state-of-the-art secure and efficient space to store our evidence. The project was put out to bid and was awarded to Construction Services Group of Neosho.” — Newton County Sheriff’s Office The evidence facility project is funded by the Public Safety Sales Tax that was passed by the voters of Newton County in 2020 and was one of the capital improvement projects promised to the voters.
“ We have outgrown the space that currently use for evidence storage, and we need to update our space to make sure that we are meeting the needs of our agency and ensuring that we are in line with industry standards ,” Sheriff Matt Stewart stated to the crowd gathered. “ I want to specifically thank the voters of Newton County for helping to make this project possible. ”
